result.topic_en: An editorial outline that sorts the pages and sheets (Blätter) of the natural-philosophy fragments into three sections: theory of knowledge (fundamental concepts, molecular mechanics, gravitation and light), psychology, and natural philosophy.
result.transcription:

S. 10 unten [-(S. 8)-] und 11 (Blatt 8), [-Widersprüche[?] der ...[?]-] S. 45. (Bedeutung der Hypothese in der Naturwissenschaft). S. 38–40 (Blatt 16 u. 17)

–45.
